ruleDefinitions.name: DNS TXT Answer with Possible Execution Strings
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects strings used in command execution in DNS TXT Answer Note: Unmapped fields: record_type, answer

sequences.query: (record_type = "TXT" AND (answer = RGX(".*IEX.*") OR answer = RGX(".*Invoke\\-Expression.*") OR answer = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe.*")))
